Authorities say that the servers in question, which may have contained advanced Nvidia AI chips, were shipped from Singapore to Malaysia.","why":"这是针对第三方的个案，芯片内容和最终目的地均未确认，也未显示英伟达业务或相关出口政策发生实质变化。"},{"id":"f","label":"colour","meaning":"2026年7月24日，英伟达、微软、Meta等公司发表联名信，呼吁决策者避免过早限制开放权重AI模型。","quote":"Nvidia , Microsoft , Meta , Palantir and more than 20 other companies released a letter Friday urging policymakers to avoid \"premature restrictions\" on open-weight artificial intelligence models that would \"stifle competition or drive innovation overseas.\"","why":"英伟达的政策立场值得保留，但联名信本身不是政府决定，也没有专门宣布针对中国模型的措施。"},{"id":"g","label":"colour","meaning":"据2026年7月24日报道，美国财长贝森特此前表示，特朗普政府将审视中国公司是否窃取美国知识产权，并称政府有能力就此实施制裁。","quote":"U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on Tuesday that the Trump administration would look into whether Chinese companies were stealing American intellectual property, and stated that the government has \"the ability to sanction them because of this theft.\"","why":"这是高层释放的潜在政策风险信号，但文章未称制裁已经实施，也未宣布针对英伟达芯片的新限制。"},{"id":"h","label":"exclude","meaning":"据2026年7月24日报道，白宫顾问Michael Kratsios称，中国Moonshot AI通过蒸馏Anthropic的技术开发了Kimi K3模型。","quote":"White House advisor Michael Kratsios on Wednesday said that China's Moonshot AI developed its Kimi K3 model by distilling Anthropic's technology.","why":"该指称涉及第三方模型技术，未直接涉及英伟达产品、财务或已采取的政策措施，单独记录的投资价值有限。"},{"id":"i","label":"core","meaning":"2026年7月6日文章称，英伟达管理层在最近一次季度电话会上预计，超大规模云服务商2026年支出将达6500亿美元，2027年将超过1万亿美元；文中未明确公司范围或是否全部为数据中心资本开支。","quote":"During its last quarterly conference call, management forecast that it expects hyperscaler spending to top $1 trillion in 2027 after reaching a projected $650 billion in 2026.","why":"这是管理层对英伟达关键客户支出的重大前瞻判断，可能影响数据中心需求预期；但不能直接视为四大云商的数据中心资本开支或已实现支出。"}]}

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 2026年7月6日文章转述，华尔街分析师预计英伟达今年剩余时间营收增长82%，2027年增长41%；文章未明确年度及统计口径。
items.quote: That sounds like further revenue growth ahead, and that's exactly what Wall Street analysts are projecting as well. For the rest of this year, they expect 82% growth. For 2027, that figure rises to 41%.
items.why: 可作为营收增长预期的背景，但匿名且期间口径不清，不能直接当作FY2027营收预测。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 2026年7月6日文章称，分析师平均预测英伟达截至2028年1月的FY2028每股收益为12.76美元。
items.quote: For fiscal 2028, ending January 2028, the average analyst projects $12.76 in earnings per share.
items.why: 下一财年的盈利预期有估值参考价值，但不是实际业绩，也不能直接回答FY2027利润问题。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 据2026年7月18日报道，SK海力士预计2027年将是内存短缺最严重的一年，短缺将持续至2030年。
items.quote: SK hynix, one of the big three memory chip manufacturers, even says that 2027 is set to be the “worst year” for the memory shortage and said that the crunch will last until 2030.
items.why: 主要供应商的行业预测为英伟达面临的内存成本和供应风险提供背景，但不是针对RTX 50 SUPER发布时间或GDDR7供应的直接预测。

items.label: core
items.meaning: 2026年7月22日，美银转述AMD的估计：在模拟100千瓦部署中，EPYC 9965的机架吞吐量约为Vera基准的2.4倍，下一代EPYC 6预计约为3.3倍。
items.quote: BofA notes that AMD estimates its EPYC 9965 (Turin) chip delivers approximately 2.4x the rack-level throughput of NVIDIA's Vera baseline in a modeled 100kW deployment, with the next-generation EPYC 6 (Venice) projected to extend that advantage to roughly 3.3x total throughput, according to BofA's characterization of AMD's own estimates.
items.why: 潜在吞吐量差距对英伟达进入服务器CPU市场及数据中心平台竞争有重要意义；但这是AMD的模拟和预测，并非独立实测，也不涵盖所有竞争指标。

items.label: exclude
items.meaning: 2026年7月2日报道称，四家公司预计于7月6日面临共八项虚假陈述欺诈指控；涉案服务器可能含英伟达先进AI芯片，最终目的地尚不明确。
items.quote: The four companies will also face a total of eight charges of fraud by false representation which are due to be announced on July 6; Authorities say that the servers in question, which may have contained advanced Nvidia AI chips, were shipped from Singapore to Malaysia.
items.why: 这是针对第三方的个案，芯片内容和最终目的地均未确认，也未显示英伟达业务或相关出口政策发生实质变化。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 2026年7月24日，英伟达、微软、Meta等公司发表联名信，呼吁决策者避免过早限制开放权重AI模型。
items.quote: Nvidia , Microsoft , Meta , Palantir and more than 20 other companies released a letter Friday urging policymakers to avoid "premature restrictions" on open-weight artificial intelligence models that would "stifle competition or drive innovation overseas."
items.why: 英伟达的政策立场值得保留，但联名信本身不是政府决定，也没有专门宣布针对中国模型的措施。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 据2026年7月24日报道，美国财长贝森特此前表示，特朗普政府将审视中国公司是否窃取美国知识产权，并称政府有能力就此实施制裁。
items.quote: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on Tuesday that the Trump administration would look into whether Chinese companies were stealing American intellectual property, and stated that the government has "the ability to sanction them because of this theft."
items.why: 这是高层释放的潜在政策风险信号，但文章未称制裁已经实施，也未宣布针对英伟达芯片的新限制。

items.label: exclude
items.meaning: 据2026年7月24日报道，白宫顾问Michael Kratsios称，中国Moonshot AI通过蒸馏Anthropic的技术开发了Kimi K3模型。
items.quote: White House advisor Michael Kratsios on Wednesday said that China's Moonshot AI developed its Kimi K3 model by distilling Anthropic's technology.
items.why: 该指称涉及第三方模型技术，未直接涉及英伟达产品、财务或已采取的政策措施，单独记录的投资价值有限。

items.label: core
items.meaning: 2026年7月6日文章称，英伟达管理层在最近一次季度电话会上预计，超大规模云服务商2026年支出将达6500亿美元，2027年将超过1万亿美元；文中未明确公司范围或是否全部为数据中心资本开支。
items.quote: During its last quarterly conference call, management forecast that it expects hyperscaler spending to top $1 trillion in 2027 after reaching a projected $650 billion in 2026.
items.why: 这是管理层对英伟达关键客户支出的重大前瞻判断，可能影响数据中心需求预期；但不能直接视为四大云商的数据中心资本开支或已实现支出。
